description_en: Sets the credit usage threshold. When a customer's available credit falls below the threshold, the reseller is notified by email. This feature is available only for Resellers and Distributors
description_zh:
通过此API设置信控使用阈值。
当客户信控到达阈值以下，会通过邮件通知分销商。
此功能仅供针对Reseller和Distributor
name: SetWarningThreshold

parameters.help_en: The UID of the reseller customer account
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en: The percentage value. Valid values: 1 to 100. When the available credit drops below this percentage of the total credit limit, an alert email is sent to the reseller partner account
parameters.help_zh: 百分比，填写范围1到100，当可用信控额度低于信控额度百分比时，触发提示邮件给分销伙伴账号
parameters.name: warning_value

Code.description_en:
The result code. Valid values:
200: OK.
1109: System error.
3040: The sub-account is frozen and the operation cannot be completed.
3044: The alert percentage value is not a number.
3045: The alert percentage value must be from 1 to 100
Code.description_zh:
结果代码:
200 OK
1109 系统错误
3040 子账号冻结，无法完成操作 - 3044 告警比例值非数字
3045 告警比例值应为1到100

Message.description_en: The message that corresponds to the Code parameter value

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. A unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求id，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the current API call was successful. Valid values: True and False. This does not indicate whether the subsequent business operation was successful
Success.description_zh: 候选值:True/False，代表了是否当前API调用本身是成功的。不代表后续 业务操作的成功
